claim_boundary: Independent finite-roster static confirmation of fixed R8/K48 single exchange and conditional R16/K9-to-K144 support rescue on the immutable joint95-v5 physical envelope. A pass authorizes only registration of a separate envelope-normalized trajectory study. It establishes neither trajectory performance, capacity reclassification, all-queue action identity, stability, nor a physical multi-GPU result.

decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_ENVELOPE_R16_SUPPORT_RESCUE_: execution, all-load support, action identity and all strict charged-work gates pass
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_STATIC_ACTION_IDENTITY_FAIL_: support passes but an action differs from its exact reference
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_STATIC_COMPUTE_FAIL_STOP: support and action identity pass but a per-lane or aggregate work gate is not strict
decision_rule.INDEPENDENT_STATIC_SUPPORT_FAIL_STOP: valid execution fails support on at least one lane and load
decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: a registered execution-integrity or triggered-rescue exactness check fails

development_result_payload.claim_boundary: An outcome-informed development replay on four consumed 512-state rosters. A pass can authorize preregistration of one new disjoint static confirmation for the fixed R8/K48-single-exchange and conditional R16 K9/K144 method. It is not independent confirmation, trajectory authorization, capacity reclassification, action identity outside these rosters, stability, an all-queue theorem, or a physical multi-GPU result.

decision_rule.INVALID_EXECUTION: one or more registered execution-integrity checks fail
decision_rule.R16_SUPPORT_RESCUE_DEVELOPMENT_ACTION_ID: support passes but a final R16 action differs from its exact reference
decision_rule.R16_SUPPORT_RESCUE_DEVELOPMENT_COMPUTE_F: support and action identity pass but charged LP, matrix, or candidate-evaluation work is not strictly below cold K4096 per roster or in aggregate
decision_rule.R16_SUPPORT_RESCUE_DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORT_F: the conditional R16 method fails a frozen physical-envelope support gate
decision_rule.R16_SUPPORT_RESCUE_READY_FOR_NEW_INDEPEN: the fixed conditional method passes support, action identity, and strict charged-work gates on all four consumed rosters and in aggregate, every triggered rescue is score/canonical exact, and retained R8 evidence passes

method_contract.charged_work: sum every work field from the primary and every actually executed rescue; each bulk call also charges all structural pair checks it performs
method_contract.primary_method: frozen K9 canonical score-tie bulk-substitution selector
method_contract.r8_disposition: retain the four frozen passing R8 source outcomes without rerun
method_contract.reference_independence: neither primary, trigger, nor rescue reads the K4096 action, score, bound, or work value
method_contract.rescue_budget_rule: 16 lanes multiplied by the frozen nine-option model cardinality
method_contract.rescue_gate: every triggered rescue selection is score-exact and canonical-exact
method_contract.rescue_method: one separate fresh cold K144 canonical score-tie bulk-substitution call
method_contract.rescue_trigger: support_epsilon_limit minus primary epsilon is not greater than the shared score tolerance
method_contract.support_epsilon_limit_source: minimum effective_slack_eta over the frozen R16 v5 physical-envelope capacity rows (the load-0.95 row)

protocol.prohibited: changing the support limit, trigger tolerance, budgets, bulk rule, work accounting, loads, or consumed rosters after registration; reading K4096 inside the trigger or rescue; using these rosters as confirmation; new rosters, arrivals, trajectories, run-time RNG, server pulls, capacity reclassification, and paper edits

r8_method_contract.certificate: retain the base certified upper bound and exactness flags; update only the feasible incumbent action, score, gap, and epsilon
r8_method_contract.charged_work: add every unique exchange attempt, including infeasible attempts, to candidate evaluations and residual option probes; add no LP or matrix work
r8_method_contract.choice: maximize exact Fraction support score; break score ties by ascending (duration, sorted option indices with idle last)
r8_method_contract.neighborhood: every unique option-count vector obtained by moving one lane from each occupied real-option or idle symbol to each different real-option or idle symbol
r8_method_contract.r16_disposition: R16/K9 is unchanged and no polish is applied
r8_method_contract.reference_independence: the polish reads no K4096 action, score, bound, or work value

selector_contract.reference: separate fresh cold K4096 per state and lane; never read by either candidate
selector_contract.support_gate: epsilon and actual normalized regret strictly below eta at all three frozen loads
